sloka: मनुजवर न कालविप्रकर्षो रिपुनिधनं प्रति यत् क्षमो ऽद्य कर्तुम्।त्वमति सृज रिपोर्वधाय वाणीममररिपोर्मथने यथा महेन्द्रः ।। ६.८४.२१ ।।
transliteration: manujavara na kālaviprakarṣo ripunidhanaṁ prati yat kṣamo 'dya kartum।tvamati sṛja riporvadhāya vāṇīmamararipormathane yathā mahendraḥ ।। 6.84.21 ।।

translations.english: 'Therefore, O mighty-armed one, commission the auspicious-marked Lakshmana for the destruction of that rakshasa, as the wielder of the thunderbolt lets loose his bolt.'
